title: 第7章 帝钟第8章 灯笼第9章 诡手
lines: 苏午睁开眼睛，看过昏暗大殿里巍然而坐的三清尊神，以及两旁显得有些臊眉耷眼的佛菩萨。
殿内双侧烛光摇曳，灯火葳蕤。
身处此间，他莫名感觉有股寒意萦绕周身。
垂头环视周遭，当下光线昏暗，像是处于夜间的大殿里，各项摆设尽皆如旧，就是不见云龙观道士们的踪影。
也不知道现在是什么时间？
苏午摸了摸衣兜，摸到衣兜里的手机，以及巴掌大的一个记事本。
自从经历过模拟器后，他就越发加固自己爱记事的习惯，决心将这个好习惯延续下去，记事本更是从不离身。
当下看来，未来的自己依然保有了这个习惯。
苏午微微安心。
通过记事本，他可以了知过去一段时间，自己经历了什么，外界又发生了什么？
正要打开记事本翻阅一二时，敞开的大殿三门外，忽然有绯红光芒照了进来，笼住殿里的泥胎塑像，以及跪坐在蒲团上的苏午。
什么东西？
殿外面的灯笼亮了？
苏午抬起头，忽然瞥见，在绯红光芒映照下，泥胎塑像面孔上的油彩‘融化’了……
一滴滴斑斓粘稠的液体从泥胎塑像脸上滑落。
每一尊泥胎塑像剥落去油彩的面孔上，都有一只漆黑的独眼。
那只眼睛像是在蠕动，缓缓将目光往苏午身上聚集。
苏午不寒而栗，也顾不得翻阅记事本了，抓起本子扭头就要跑——
就在他起身的瞬间，一层层粘稠如泥浆的黑暗从泥胎塑像脚下蔓延，覆压了绯红色的光芒，漫淹到苏午自身！
他忽然定在原地。
半转着身，看到道观山门外的黑暗苍穹上，升起一只只血红色的‘灯笼’，灯笼如星河，笼罩了云龙观所在的矮山。
覆盖了远处依稀灯火辉煌的明州市。
门外也不安全！
苏午内心闪过最后一个念头。
粘稠的黑暗淹没了整座大殿，黑暗里响起咀嚼骨头的声音。
“你死了。”
“本次模拟结束。”
“评分：无。
评语：不作死就不会死。
奖励：无。”
“本次可带出模拟游戏的物品有如下几项，可消耗一定数量的元玉选择带出某几项物品。”
选项0：签筒。
选项2：解签书。
选项3：香烛纸钱。
content_en:
Su Wu opened his eyes and saw the three pure gods sitting majestically in the dark hall, as well as the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas on both sides who looked a little shy.
Candlelight flickered on both sides of the hall, and the lights were bright.
While here, he felt an inexplicable chill lingering around him.
He lowered his head and looked around. The light was dim at the moment, as if he were in the main hall at night. All the furnishings were the same as before, but there was no sign of the Taoist priests from Yunlong Temple.
Don’t know what time it is now?
Su Wu touched his pocket and found the cell phone and a palm-sized notepad in his pocket.
Since experiencing the simulator, he has strengthened his habit of taking notes and is determined to continue this good habit, and the notepad will never leave his side.
It seems now that my future self still retains this habit.
Su Wu felt slightly relieved.
Through the notepad, he can understand what he has experienced in the past period of time and what has happened in the outside world.
Just when he was about to open his notepad and read through it, crimson light suddenly shone in from outside the three open doors of the main hall, enveloping the clay statues in the hall and Su Wu kneeling on the futon.
What?
Are the lanterns outside the temple lit?
Su Wu raised his head and suddenly saw that under the crimson light, the paint on the face of the clay statue 'melted'...
Drops of colorful and viscous liquid slipped from the face of the clay statue.
Each clay statue has a single, pitch-black eye on its peeled-off face.
The eye seemed to be moving, and it slowly focused its gaze on Su Wu.
Su Wu shuddered and didn't care to look through the notebook. He grabbed the notebook and turned around to run away——
The moment he stood up, layers of darkness as thick as mud spread from the feet of the clay statue, covering up the crimson light and flooding Su Wu himself!
He suddenly froze in place.
Half-turning around, he saw blood-red 'lanterns' rising in the dark sky outside the gate of Taoist Temple. The lanterns were like a river of stars, covering the short mountain where Yunlong Temple was located.
Covering the dimly lit Mingzhou City in the distance.
It's not safe outside the door!
Su Wu's last thought flashed through his heart.
Thick darkness flooded the entire hall, and the sound of chewing bones resounded in the darkness.
…
"You're dead."
"This simulation is over."
"Rating: None.
Comment: If you don’t seek death, you won’t die.
Reward: None. "
"The following items can be brought out of the simulation game this time. You can consume a certain amount of Yuan Yu to choose to bring out certain items."
Option 0: Lottery tube.
Option 2: Unsign the book.
Option 3: Incense candles and paper money.
